views.title: How are we doing?
views.description: Campaign health measures campaigns without current runtime errors; repository coverage measures registered repositories reached by successful worker execution.

views.title: Campaign overview
views.intent: Show the registered campaign and repository inventory while preserving their investigation routes.

views.title: Campaigns
views.intent: Provide direct navigation to every registered campaign through the same Insights route used by the campaign inventory.

queries.name: maintenance-repository-versions
queries.intent: Group installed and current gh-aw compiler versions and upgrade evidence by repository.

queries.name: maintenance-repositories
queries.intent: List each repository with compiler versions and an explicit upgrade recommendation.

queries.name: maintenance-campaign-updates
queries.intent: Expose at most one CAO package update row for the Updates navigation indicator.

queries.name: maintenance-repository-upgrades
queries.intent: Expose at most one gh-aw compiler upgrade row for the Updates navigation indicator.

queries.name: campaign-runtime-health-runs
queries.intent: Project only the run and workflow fields required to classify current campaign runtime health.
queries.description: A bounded runtime-health input that excludes audit outcomes and presentation-only campaign run fields.

queries.name: campaign-runtime-health-groups
queries.intent: Compute each campaign workflow and runtime repository's latest consecutive failure streak in the selected horizon.
queries.description: Current retained failure streaks grouped by campaign workflow and runtime repository, considering only concluded Runs so an in-flight retry cannot mask an active failure streak.

queries.name: campaign-runtime-problem-candidates
queries.intent: Mark campaign workflow and runtime repository partitions whose latest retained run streak is failing.
queries.description: Campaign runtime partitions annotated with whether their current retained streak contains failures.

queries.name: campaign-current-runtime-failures
queries.intent: Show only campaign workflow and runtime repository partitions whose latest retained run streak is failing.
queries.description: Campaign runtime partitions with one or more consecutive failures after their latest retained success.

queries.name: workflow-run-observation-counts
queries.intent: Count retained Runs for each workflow identity in the selected horizon.
queries.description: One row per organization, repository, and workflow with retained Run counts, safe to join without row multiplication.

queries.name: campaign-active-orchestrator-run-presence
queries.intent: Count retained Runs for each active campaign orchestrator in the selected horizon.
queries.description: Active campaign orchestrators annotated with retained Run presence.

queries.name: campaign-unobserved-orchestrator-candidates
queries.intent: Mark active campaign orchestrators with no retained Runs in the selected horizon.
queries.description: Active orchestrators annotated with whether runtime evidence is absent.

queries.name: campaign-unobserved-orchestrators
queries.intent: Show active campaign orchestrators with no retained Runs in the selected horizon.
queries.description: Active campaign orchestrators whose runtime state cannot be established from retained evidence.

queries.name: campaign-runtime-problems
queries.intent: Combine current runtime failures with active orchestrators that have no retained Run evidence.
queries.description: Current campaign runtime problems requiring investigation.

queries.name: database-campaign-count
queries.intent: Count campaigns in the dashboard database.

queries.name: overview-run-summary
queries.intent: Summarize successful, failed, and active runs with rollout-mode counts.

queries.name: overview-delivery-summary
queries.intent: Count distinct target repositories with successful worker dispatch runs in the selected horizon.

queries.name: overview-value-summary
queries.intent: Count all observed grader results.

queries.name: overview-run-status-input
queries.intent: Prepare the compact run summary for declarative factory status classification.

queries.name: overview-value-status-input
queries.intent: Prepare the compact value summary for declarative factory status classification.

queries.name: overview-factory-status
queries.intent: Classify the factory heading from compact run and optional value evidence.

queries.name: overview-registered-repository-summary
queries.intent: Count canonical repository identities registered in the resolved control-plane scope.

queries.name: overview-delivery-coverage-input
queries.intent: Prepare successful delivery totals for the repository coverage summary.

queries.name: overview-registered-repository-coverage-input
queries.intent: Prepare registered repository totals for the repository coverage summary.

queries.name: overview-rhythm
queries.intent: Show current-week successful runs from Monday through today and the matching previous-week count for weekdays not yet reached.

queries.name: campaign-runtime-problem-counts
queries.intent: Count current failing workflow and runtime repository partitions for each campaign.
queries.description: Current retained runtime problem counts by campaign.

queries.name: overview-repository-coverage-summary
queries.intent: Aggregate reached and total repositories across the resolved organization scope.

queries.name: overview-repository-coverage
queries.intent: Measure registered repository reach from successful worker execution.

queries.name: overview-healthy-campaign-count
queries.intent: Count campaigns with no retained workflow or target errors.

queries.name: overview-campaign-count-presentation-input
queries.intent: Prepare the campaign inventory count for Overview presentation queries.

queries.name: overview-healthy-campaign-presentation-input
queries.intent: Prepare the healthy campaign count for Overview presentation queries.

queries.name: overview-campaign-health-presentation
queries.intent: Produce presentation-ready campaign health values for the Overview header and floor.

queries.name: overview-header-status-presentation-input
queries.intent: Prepare the factory status heading for the declarative Overview header.

queries.name: overview-header-presentation
queries.intent: Resolve the Overview heading from declarative status and campaign-health evidence.

queries.name: overview-run-motion-presentation-input

queries.name: overview-campaign-station
queries.intent: Provide the presentation-ready campaign health station for Overview.

queries.name: overview-repository-station
queries.intent: Provide the presentation-ready repository coverage station for Overview.

queries.name: overview-disabled-dispatchers
queries.intent: Identify campaigns whose dispatcher is disabled in GitHub Actions.

queries.intent: Provide one navigation row per registered campaign that opens its dedicated campaign view.
queries.description: Registered campaigns with a resolved dashboard link to their dedicated campaign view.
